text_block_list.text:
One day, while preparing for training, an 
Umamusume came storming over with great 
fervor.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this! I'm definitely 
gonna be number one!
choice_data_list: You're really fired up, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, today's the mock race! You have no 
idea how long I've been looking forward to 
this day...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'll run with everything I've got, put up 
great results, and then, someday, I'm 
gonna become a Triple Crown Umamusume just 
like President Rudolf――!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Gh!? *cough*, *cough*!! I-It went down 
the wrong pipe...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew... whew... I-I'm fine... really. My 
body just never quite keeps up with my 
spirit...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If I push too hard here and collapse, that 
mock race will be put on hold... B-But 
still, I really want to train.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Gnuuugh... What do we do, Tsuyoshi~?!
choice_data_list: Let's warm up with a jog.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I see! Stretching doesn't overtax the 
body, and it's perfect for preventing 
injuries!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: All right, forward bends first! Hnngh!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, *crack*... I-I leaned in... way 
too hard...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine... Just need to take it slower, 
more carefully...

Fortunately, it seemed she hadn't injured 
herself. I watched over Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi 
for a while as she resumed stretching with 
extra care.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I see! Warm up and loosen the body! That 
way, there's no straining anything!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
! Time to give my jogging everything I've 
got—!!

No sooner had she spoken than Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi began running with an intensity 
that looked nothing like a mere jog.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! You're right! I just got totally 
ahead of myself.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Nice and slow! Easy does it! Off I go 
again!
